translation_snapshot.source: Renders a random talent unavailable. Talent cooldown is halved until the effect has worn off.
translation_snapshot.target: 随机使一个技能无法使用。该状态下所有技能冷却速度减半。

translation_snapshot.source:
A gaunt vaguely humanoid shape featuring unadorned grey leathery skin. Its arms and legs seem somehow too long and it stands tall, projecting an ominous shadow even in darkness.
Its glowing red eyes shine with both cruelty and a deep frightening intellect.
translation_snapshot.target:
一个憔悴而模糊不清的人形生物，全身是未经修饰的灰色皮肤。不知为何，它的胳膊和腿很长。当它耸立在那里的时候，即使在黑暗中也会投下不祥的阴影。
它发光的红色眼睛闪烁着，目光里蕴含着既残酷又深邃可怕的智慧。

translation_snapshot.source:
You expend massive amounts of energy to launch yourself across %d squares at incredible speed. All enemies in your path will be knocked flying and dealt between %d and %d Physical damage.
		At talent level 5, you can batter through solid walls.
translation_snapshot.target:
冲锋 %d 码。
		路径上的敌人会被击退并受到 %d 至 %d 点物理伤害。
		技能等级 5 时你能冲过墙壁。

translation_snapshot.source:
A bulging rotten robe seems to tear at the seams, with masses of bloated worms spilling out all around the moving form.  Two arm-like appendages, each made up of overlapping mucous-drenched maggots, grasp tightly around the handles of bile-coated waraxes.
Each swing drips pustulant fluid before it, and each droplet writhes and wriggles in the air before splashing against the ground.
translation_snapshot.target: 一件鼓鼓囊囊的腐烂长袍，长袍的缝隙里不断蠕动着浮肿的蠕虫。它有着两只臂膀一样的附属物，每只都由沾满黏液的蛆重叠而成，各握着一柄覆有胆汁的斧子。每一次挥舞都会向前溅出脓液，每一滴脓液在空中扭动翻滚，然后啪嗒一声落在地上。
